reviews.comment: I don't think it is possible for a professor to be better. If you want to get by and get a good grade you got it. If you also want to learn she will provide so many optional practice problems that you will iron out any wrinkles you might have in understanding. An amazing person and professor. I wish I could learn all of math from her.

My favorite math professor ever! She is so kind and helps even when it isn't her math class you need help with. She is so funny and makes class comfortable. Lots of examples during lectures that are interactive and helpful. Very clear and fair grading. No curveballs at all. She is so lovely and if you can take her you should!!!!!

Professor Holmes is an amazing and caring professor.  She truly wants every one of her students to succeed. She is amazing at explaining her material. However the grading only relies on weekly quizzes, mid terms and the final exam. Bad test takers do not take her, over eighty percent of the class is based on 3 exams.

Dr. Holmes is one of the best professors I've had. She is incredibly understanding and cares for each of her students. She always responds when you reach out. Her lectures are informative. There are weekly quizzes, which aren't difficult, and optional homework. Exams are fairly straightforward. I can't stress enough how great of a professor she is.

TAKE DR. HOLMES. She is by far one of the best profs I've ever had. She was so kind and really good at explaining things. She prepares you for all of the tests really well with homework and practice tests so if you try at all its very easy to get an A. If you have the chance to take her for any class absolutely do!!!

Professor Holmes has been, by far, the best professor I have had since I started college. She doesn't have homework due, only puts assignments up on her website for people to do on their own. She deeply cares that everyone in her class succeeds. She is also very understanding, if you skip class/quiz if you're sick, you can make it up, no issue.
Amazing professor and has very concise and helpful notes

Dr. Holmes is an amazing professor and makes class fun and engaging! She is not a tough grader and allows your final to replace a midterm grade. Her lectures are organized perfectly and are always posted on her website!

Dr. Holmes is by far the best professor I have ever had. She makes an effort to get to know her students and is eager to answer any question you have, no matter how small or silly. She is very accessible outside of class and grades very fairly and consistently. She posts the lecture notes for every class, and grades are based on quizzes and exams.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: One of the best professors I ever had. She was accessible in groupme and was very helpful in posting notes and helping students out when they needed it. She also had a very straightforward class. I would highly suggest her.

I took this class Spring 2022 and she's honestly the best prof I've had at TAMU! Very understanding and has a clear outline of what she expects from you. One weekly quiz, optional homework, and easily accessible through the groupme.

By far one of my favorite profs I've had as a math major here at A&M! She takes very concise and easy to read notes, and her weekly quizzes were super easy! She is very accessible and active on the class GroupMe. Diff Eq was made way easier thanks to her very simple but engaging lectures. An easy A if you work for it.

Dr. Holmes is the best professor I have had. I took her for M172 and again for M308 and I can't thank her enough for helping me through each course. Many students struggle with Diff Eq but she made it extremely enjoyable. She gives weekly quizzes that are great at preparing you for her exams. If you put in a little bit of effort, it's an easy A.

The best M308 professor there is. Lectures were extremely detailed and well written. Outside notes on top of that were given so there were 2 sets of notes to look from, plus written out homework solutions and detailed explanations. Was accessible basically 24/7 and was extremely helpful and taught the material really well. 100% would retake!
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Holmes is the best professor I've ever had. She does a great job at explaining things, and her lecture notes are easy to follow. She really does care about you doing well, if you reach out to her she'll be more than happy to help. For her exams she takes the questions straight from the review, so if you study that you'll do great in the class!

Professor Holmes is a great teacher! She posts copies of all the notes used in lecture AND makes totally separate notes that are more neat/detailed to read later. Posts thorough solutions to all hw/quizzes; inhumanly fast grader; very available (made us a groupme). She's funny and she wants us to succeed: I have only positive things to say.

Most approachable prof ever. Made "pretty notes" & HELPFUL study guides. Takes EXCELLENT notes. Actively used class GroupMe. Answered questions quickly. Gave 5 point freebie on each (free response) exam & reasonable optional homework (DO IT OR FAIL). VERY FAST GRADER. DiffEq is no joke but she made it fun & easy, so long as you didn't fall behind!
She's amazing!! Take her if you get the chance!

She is a great math professor and details what you will need to succeed in the course. Hilarious on chat and in class. Engages with students very well and is easily accessible. Her notes can be messy, but they great. I didnt attend lecture, but was able to grasp mostly everything with her notes and review.

Professor Holmes is without a doubt the best math teacher I have ever had. She gives amazing feedback, helps me with my other math classes, and is an all around fun professor to have. 1000/10 would recomend.
She gives you everything and more to ensure you get an A! She is amazing! I took her for Math 172 and I am taking her again for 308. Highly recommend.

I took Dr. Holmes for MATH172 and she was an absolute pleasure. Similarly to her Calc 2 course, her Diff Eq course is identical in strategy: If you take good notes, pay attention in class, and do her study guides/ quizzes, you will do well on her exams. No Textbook needed, just pay attention in lecture and practice as much as possible.

Dr. Holmes is an absolute BEAST! Her lectures are always super entertaining and they are never the same old 'read from a powerpoint'. She gives very fair quizzes and is super understanding. She gives coursework that adequately prepares you for her exams. I started the semester with a 67 and ended with a 96. HIGHLY RECOMMENDED!!!

Terrific teacher! Shes cool and Explains mathematics and proves concepts in a very clear manner. You will actually learn math in this class. You have one easy quiz per week, 30 optional homework problems, and tests. She gives enough prep material for you to do well on tests. The tests are of medium difficulty and graded leniently.

It is a shame that Professor Holmes rating is as low as it is at this time of writing. She is an absolutely amazing professor - great notes and clear expectations. Concepts are broken down to a conceptual level but not overwhelming with proofs. Exams were graded by the next day. High interaction with students. 10/10, I have enjoyed every minute

Not the best exams... all free-response, very few partial points and no curves. Quizzes each week are medium difficulty and can help ur grade. Lectures are boring, and long and dont help much since it's so fast-paced. Overall try another prof if available.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Holmes is by far the best math professor I've ever had in my life, and she cares a lot about her students. Go to her office hours and the lectures, that definitely helped me. Her exams are made up of the homework and review she assigns. I definitely had to work hard for this class, but an A is attainable if you're willing to work for it.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: The class is difficult, but she is an amazing professor and I wish she would teach higher level math classes so I could take her classes again. Office hours are very helpful

Does not lecture on material related to the course. Gives way too many proofs and theorems to memorize. Exams are the MOST difficult I have ever taken in Calculus. All short answer, terribly difficult compared to homeworks and quizzes, very little partial credit, and extremely tough grader. Awful experience and DO NOT TAKE THIS PROF.
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Tough grader
